name: CarparkAvailability
description: Singapore Carpark Availability dashboard (OutSystems 11, Reactive Web).

HighAvailabilityMinPct.description: A lot type is High availability when MORE than this percentage of lots is free.

LowAvailabilityMaxPct.description: Low availability below this percentage (with at least one free lot); Moderate between Low and High (inclusive).

StaleAfterMinutes.description: Data older than this, measured from the data.gov.sg reading time, is labelled Stale.

ReadingOutdatedMinutes.description: A carpark reading this much older than the dataset timestamp is flagged as not recently updated.

CacheTtlSeconds.description: How long a successful retrieval is reused before calling data.gov.sg again.

MinRefreshIntervalSeconds.description: Even a user-forced refresh reuses cached data younger than this (upstream burst protection).

CarparkInfoMaxAgeHours.description: How often the HDB Carpark Information address cache is re-synchronised.

HdbCarparkInfoResourceId.description: data.gov.sg datastore resource id of the HDB Carpark Information dataset.

DataGovApiKey.description: Optional data.gov.sg API key sent as x-api-key. Secret: never stored in this repository.
